title: speeeecies locale flora catalog v0.1
description: The plants a locale's garden shows, contributed as `locales/<id>/flora-catalog.json` next to `locale.json`. The simulation imports it as it is, in place of its generic biome catalog. It has the simulation's flora-catalog shape, with stricter sources: every source carries an allow-listed licence. Each `taxon` must be one the simulation can draw (`schema/v0.1/flora-taxa.json`); the local species it represents goes in `stand_in_for`. See docs/locale-richness.md.

source.description: Where the catalog came from. For a contributed catalog: `{"repo": "speeeecies", "rev": "locales/<id>"}`.

ResourceTag.description: What the plant offers animals, matched against the `habitat.resources[].tag` values species use (`berry`, `seed`, `nectar`, `perch`, `shrub_thicket`, `cavity`, `nest_cup`, `invertebrate`, `leaf_litter`, ...), or `host:<name>`.

title.description: Also the attribution line: required unless the licence is CC0 or public domain, e.g. `Wikipedia contributors, "Ilex aquifolium", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0`.

taxon.description: A taxon from `schema/v0.1/flora-taxa.json`: the model the simulation draws.

stand_in_for.description: The local species this entry represents when `taxon` is a stand-in, e.g. `Ilex aquifolium` for `Ilex opaca`. Hybrid signs are dropped (`Tilia europaea`).

community_weight.description: Relative share of this plant, keyed by the locale id. An entry without a positive weight for its locale is never placed.

native_status.description: Keyed by the locale id. The import weights Native and NativeAndIntroduced plants 1.0 and the rest 0.3, on top of `community_weight`.
